name: Silent Poisoner (Ex)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Rogue Talents, Advanced
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A rogue who selects this talent gains the poison use and no trace ninja abilities, using half her rogue level as her effective ninja level to determine the bonuses she gains from the no trace class feature. If the rogue already has the poison use class feature, she gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against poison instead.
